info.title: Magikitos World JSON API
info.description: Public content, shared website identity, private progress and a server-authoritative shared forest. JSON only; backend implementation stays in the private website repository.

post.summary: Mint a short-lived, signed live-world ticket
post.description: No user id, role, position or avatar accepted in the request. Identity and spawn come from the authenticated website account; cannot mint a ticket for a banned account.

Requires a current on-foot player observation from the signed loopback authority, not browser position. One leaf and one deadline change per operation. Poop creates a bare shared trace lasting 24 hours in a shared zone.

post.summary: Publish verbatim text on the author's fresh dropping
post.description: Immediate plaintext publication in any language; no content judge or review. Server requires a live on-foot player, own trace made within the last 5 minutes, within 2 tiles, writing tools, one twig and 50 tiles between notes. Existing 24-hour expiry is unchanged. Idempotent by operationId.

get.description: Existing bearer identity. Samples initial pee/poop deadlines once per account; never imports deadlines from a client save.

get.summary: Read live droppings and notes in one shared zone
get.description: No content verification. Notes are plain user text in any language and must be rendered as text, never HTML. A null text is a bare dropping. Expired and manually removed rows are excluded immediately. Coordinates and timestamps are world pixels and epoch milliseconds.

post.summary: Place, move or dismantle an owned non-heritage object
post.description: JSON only. Existing bearer identity and a live player seat observed on foot in the requested zone are required. Spectators or clients without a live observation receive live_player_required (403); a different scene receives live_zone_required (403); an unavailable authority returns live_unavailable (503), without spending resources. 120 requests/minute/IP; construction additionally 12 writes/minute/user. No general analytics events. Server catalog, prerequisites, costs, terrain and permissions are authoritative.

post.summary: Explicit player use; no simulated-NPC reputation
post.description: JSON only. Existing bearer identity and a live player seat observed on foot in the object's zone are required; the client cannot supply role or position. No live player: live_player_required (403). Different scene: live_zone_required (403). Authority unavailable: live_unavailable (503). 120 requests/minute/IP. No general analytics events. Reputation signals require a different, contacted account aged at least seven days; once per account/object. No foreign modification rights are enabled.

Same collector as the website's own /api/track: one allow-list of event types, one table, one 400-day sweep. Always answers 204 and never tells the client anything; unknown event types are dropped silently. Bot traffic is discarded server-side by user agent. Sent with navigator.sendBeacon.

post.summary: Set the single little bomb from the sack on another player's object
post.description: JSON only. Same live seat and zone rules as community-build. Consumes the caller's `bomba` (cap 1 per account, earned in-game), refuses heritage objects, protected corners, paths (`bombable: false`), objects already mined and callers without a bomb; validates the optional note with the forest-notes policy; writes history (`mine`), bumps the zone revision and notifies the author (`forest_bomb`). The fuse (construction.bomb.fuseMs) is enforced by the website cron; the DTO carries `explodesAt` as absolute server time.

post.summary: Defuse a little bomb with the pliers, silently
post.description: JSON only. Same live seat and zone rules as community-build. Consumes the caller's `desactivador`, clears the bomb, writes history (`defuse`) and bumps the zone revision. Nobody is notified.

variant.description: The playable duende this session enters with, the same one the ticket signs and the forest shows to everyone else.

text.description: Verbatim, untranslated user text; no approval status. Render with textContent.

title.description: Localized description of the sheet; the artwork itself has no language

image.description: Full-size AVIF master, for viewing and printing

thumb.description: 300px AVIF variant for grids; falls back to the master when absent

User.description: Public contributor identity; no private fields

Thread.description: Existing private guardian-thread DTO; may include reclaim/publication hints owned by the website

GameState.description: Private bounded snapshot, not server-attested progression or website money. Allowed keys, item caps, balance cap and scene coordinates are validated against the installed data contract. Timestamps in milliseconds. Never public.

GameSave.description: New: profileId=null, baseRevision=0. Later: last acknowledged ID/revision. Retry identical payload/operationId until acknowledged. Personal puzzle positions only: state.objects must not contain authored shared props.

GameSaveResponse.description: Last 16 receipts retained. A late replay returns current profile and original acknowledgedRevision; differing revisions require conflict resolution.

progress.description: Server-owned flags, timers and one-time reward receipts.

resources.description: Region renewal cycles and compact collected-node hex bitsets.

avatar.description: Chosen playable duende, or null while nobody has said. Validated against the installed release's live.avatars, never against a stored list.

createdAt.description: Original UTC placement time, preserved when moving. Flowers mature after their definition's growAfterMs.

bomb.description: A little bomb set on this object (AUTOMANTENIMIENTO §B). Server-owned absolute time; the client never computes remaining minutes.

explodesAt.description: Unix ms when the cron retires the object.

steps.description: Paths only: per segment, the zone presence clock (minutes) of the last footstep, marked by the live daemon. Read against CommunitySnapshot.clock.

now.description: Authoritative server Unix time in milliseconds. Plant growth uses this clock, never the device calendar.

clock.description: Zone presence clock in minutes: advances only while someone is in the scene. Never a wall-clock date.

object.description: place: kind,variant,x,y,rotation. move: id,revision,x,y,rotation. remove: id,revision. Catalog identity is immutable after placement.

device_id.description: UUID from magikito.discovery, shared with the website

variant.description: One of the playable duendes the installed release offers.

note.description: Optional message left beside the bomb; same policy as forest notes (adventure.messages.maxCharacters).
